get.summary: Endpoint to get autocomplete suggestions for title, creator, and series.
get.description:
Use this endpoint to get autocomplete suggestions for title, creator, and series.
- 'query' - Base query to autocomplete
- 'sortBy' - Specifies which property of the response to sort by (optional, default is to not sort)
- 'categorySize' - Specifies the number of suggestions we'll attempt to retrieve per selected category. Does not guarantee there will be up to this number. (optional, default is 5)
- 'maxSize' - The maximum number of results to return (does not guarantee this many results). This will truncate the result set as the last step is the result set is larger then this size. (optional, default is to not truncate)
- 'deduplicate' - Whether to deduplicate entries with the same text (ignoring case, punctuation, and spacing) by taking the one with the highest score, regardless of category, at the end of the filtering process (optional, default is true)
- 'field' - Which fields to get suggestions on (optional, default is `title`, `creator`, and `series`)
- 'mediaType' - Media type filters (optional, default is all)

get.summary: Endpoint to retrieve all the checkouts for a library card using credential-based tokens.
get.description:
Use this endpoint to retrieve all the checkouts for a library card.
- 'libraryKey' - A unique key that identifies the library
- 'mediaTypes' - List of mediaTypes to filter the checkout response for
- 'format' - List of formats to filter the checkout response for
- 'flatten' - Whether to flatten the nested checkouts (defaults to true)
- 'includeMetadata' - A flag indicating whether or not to include the title metadata with the bookshelf data
- 'page' - The results page being requested (defaults to 1)
- 'perPage' - The number of items to return per page (max of 100, defaults to 24)
- 'omitBundledMetadata' - If flatten = false and includeMetadata = true, setting this to true will skip the metadata call for bundled children. Will not include the BundledContent, but will instead populate BundledContentTitleIds

post.summary: Endpoint to checkout a title using credential-based tokens.
post.description: Use this endpoint to checkout a title. - 'libraryKey' - A unique key that identifies the library - 'request' - JSON request body. See "Implementation notes" for more info. Notes about parameters The id passed in the request body can be a reserveId or titleId. Lending period: - Describes the length of time that a title can be checked out. - May vary by library, title, or format. - You can retrieve possible lending periods for a title from the `GET /v2/libraries/{libraryKey}/patrons/me/periods/{titleId}` endpoint. - When no lending period is passed in the request, the library's default lending period for that title's media type is used. Units: - Describes the time unit for a lending period, typically days. Client: - Describes who's calling the endpoint, used in reporting. We recommend passing a version number along with your client name (e.g. "myApp v1.6").

get.summary: Endpoint to get the download link for a checkout using credential-based tokens.
get.description:
Use this endpoint to get a link to download a borrowed title.
- 'libraryKey' - A unique key that identifies the library
- 'titleId' - A unique id for a titleA unique id that identifies the content (this can be title or reserve ID)
- 'formatType' - The requested format for a title (e.g. ebook-pdf-adobe, periodicals-nook, etc.)
- 'successPageUrl' - The location a user is sent after successful fulfillment (required for periodicals-nook only)
- 'errorPageUrl' - The location a user is sent if there's a fulfillment error

Download links expire after 60 seconds. If a download link isn't fulfilled within the 60-second time limit, a new request must be made for a fresh download link.

Once you get a download link for a title and "lock in" a format, it cannot be returned through the `DELETE /v2/libraries/{libraryKey}/patrons/me/checkouts/{titleId}` endpoint. Formats that do NOT require the format to be locked in: ebook-overdrive, audiobook-overdrive, and ebook-kobo.

get.summary: Endpoint to search titles.
get.description:
Use this endpoint to search titles.
To get all of possible values for the formats, maturityLevel, mediaType, sortOptions, and subject parameters, run a search using only a libraryKey and perPage=0. In the results, you'll retrieve all the parameter values available for that library.
- 'libraryKey' - A unique id for a library
- 'query' - A search query
- 'mediaTypes' - A media type filter that allows and/or logic
- 'title' - A title name filter
- 'series' - A series name filter
- 'seriesId' - A series id filter
- 'publisherId' - A publisher id filter
- 'publisherEntityId' - The publisher entity id to filter to
- 'imprintId' - A imprint id filter
- 'identifier' - An identifier filter (e.g. ISBN)
- 'creator' - A creator name filter
- 'creatorId' - A creator id filter
- 'addedDate' - Filter that includes titles added within a certain range of days (e.g. `days-0-7`, `days-0-14`, etc.)
- 'availableFirst' - Order results by availability (defaults to false)
- 'showOnlyAvailable' -  Filter that shows only available titles (defaults to false)
- 'excludeNormallyAvailable' - Filter that excludes 'normally' available (non-lucky day) titles (defaults to false). Combine with `showOnlyLuckyDayAvailable` to return titles that have only lucky day availability. 
- 'showOnlyLuckyDayAvailable' - Filter that shows only available titles through Lucky Day (defaults to false)
- 'showOnlyPrerelease' - Filter that shows only pre-release titles (defaults to false)
- 'hasAudioSynchronizedText' - Filter that shows only titles with audio synchronized text
- 'format' - A format filter (e.g. ebook-overdrive, ebook-epub-adobe, etc.)
- 'subject' - A subject filter (numerical ids, retrieved from subject endpoint)
- 'excludeSubject' - A subject exclusion filter (numerical ids, retrieved from subject endpoint)
- 'bisacCode' - A bisac code filter (e.g. FIC002000
- 'excludedBisacCodes' - Bisac codes to be excluded from the search results, i.e. any title with any of these codes will be filtered out
- 'maturityLevel' - A maturity level filter (e.g. juvenile, youngadult, etc.)
- 'language' - A language filter (e.g. en, es, etc.)
- 'atosLevel' - An ATOS level filter (e.g. `0-1`, `5-6`, etc.)
- 'lexileScore' - A lexile score filter (e.g. `0-200`, `1000-1200`, etc.)
- 'interestLevel' - An interest level filter (`lower-grades`, `middle-grades`, `middle-grades-plus`, `upper-grades`)
- 'gradeLevel' - A grade level filter (e.g. `pre-kindergarten`, `kindergarten`, `grade-5`, `grade-12`, etc.)
- 'awards' - An award id filter
- 'sortBy' - Sort options for the results (e.g. newlyadded, mostpopular, etc., sorted by relevancy by default)
- 'show' - Filter that shows `owned`, `unowned`, `all`, or `recommendable` titles (defaults to owned)
- 'overdriveFormats' - *Temporary* filter that restricts returned formats to OverDrive Read or Listen.
- 'page' - The results page being requested (defaults to 1)
- 'perPage' - The number of items to return per page (max of 100, defaults to 24)
- 'includeFacets' - A value indicating whether or not to return facets along with the search results
- 'includeNoFormatTitles' - A value indicating whether or not to include media titles that do not have any formats
- 'filterCpcTitles' - If set to true, all CPC titles will be filtered from the results. If false, CPC titles may still be filtered by other parameters.
- 'collectionId' - The curated collection Id to filter to
- 'titleIds' - A comma-separated list of title ids (this can be title or reserve ID)
- 'maxItems' - The maximum amount of items to return from the search
- 'breakpoint' - The breakpoint to use when performing a filtered maxitems search
- 'contentMask' - The content mask to use to filter content from the search
- 'seed' - The randomization seed to use when requesting a randomized sort (only required for pagination consistency)
- 'includedFacets' - The facets to include in this media search (default is to return all of them)
- 'passedInRequest' - The original http request when called from another controller method
- 'subjectOrBisac' - Boolean search with subjects/bisac codes
- 'lexisNexisPracticeArea' - A LexisNexis practice area subject filter (numerical ids)
- 'lexisNexisJurisdiction' - A LexisNexis jurisdiction subject filter (numerical ids)
- 'lexisNexisContentType' - A LexisNexis content type subject filter (numerical ids)
- 'searchBehavior' - The name of the calling client, used to modify search behavior as needed
- 'applyAdvantageFilter' - Boolean to apply the advantage filtering for search requests (defaults to false)
- 'audiobookDuration' - An audiobook duration filter in hours (e.g. `0-1`, `5-6`, etc.)
- 'truncateDescription' - Boolean to use short description first, if null the truncated full description is used. When false, use full description if it exists, otherwise use short description  (default true)
- 'useDefaultQuotable' - Boolean to use 'defaultquotable' query type to allow exact-matching quoted text. Supported values: 'all', 'firstinseries', 'standalone'
- 'freshStart' - Filter for titles that are first in series, standalone, or both
- 'explain' - Boolean indicating the search request should be returned instead of the result

get.summary: Endpoint to search series.
get.description:
Use this endpoint to search series.
- 'libraryKey' - A unique key that identifies the library
- 'query' - A search query
- 'addedDate' - The date added
- 'seriesName' - The name of the series
- 'mediaType' - Media type filters (optional, default is all)
- 'format' - Format filter (e.g. ebook-overdrive, ebook-epub-adobe, etc.)
- 'subject' - A subject filter (numerical ids, retrieved from subject endpoint)
- 'language' - Language filter (e.g. en, es, etc.)
- 'includedFacets (bool)' - A value indicating whether or not to return facets along with the search results
- 'bisacCode' - A bisac code filter (e.g. FIC002000)
- 'jurisdiction' - DEPRECATED: use lexisNexisJurisdiction
- 'practiceArea' - DEPRECATED: use lexisNexisPracticeArea
- 'classification' - DEPRECATED: use lexisNexisContentType
- 'lexisNexisJurisdiction' - LexisNexis custom subject filter
- 'lexisNexisPracticeArea' - LexisNexis custom subject filter
- 'lexisNexisContentType' - LexisNexis custom subject filter
- 'sortBy' - Sort options for the results (e.g. newlyadded, mostpopular, etc., sorted by relevancy by default)
- 'page' - The results page being requested (defaults to 1)
- 'perPage' - The number of items to return per page (max of 100, defaults to 24)
- 'collectionId' - The curated collection Id to filter to
- 'includeFacets' - Facets to include in the response
- 'imprintId' - A imprint id filter
- 'publisherId' - A publisher id filter
- 'publisherEntityId' - The publisher entity id to filter to
- 'creatorId' - A creator id filter
- 'explain' - Boolean indicating the search request should be returned instead of the result

Endpoint to get all subjects for a library.
get.description:
Use this endpoint to get all subjects for a library.
- 'libraryKey' - A unique key that identifies the library
- 'mediaType' - A content media type filter (ex: ebook, audiobook, etc...)
- 'subject' - A subject filter (ex: 118 [inspirational]). Note: this will still return other subjects since the titles with the requested subject have other subjects.
- 'maturityLevel' - A maturity level filter (ex: juvenile, youngadult, etc...)
- 'language' - A language filter (ex: en)
- 'includeNoFormatTitles' - Include titles that do not have a format in the search results. Defaults to false.
- 'onlySiteFormats' - Filter titles that do not have a site-supported format. Defaults to true.
- 'showOnlyAvailable' - Filter to only titles which are Available. Defaults to false, showing available and unavailable titles.
